record.question: Among Tasar food plants, the following varieties are propagated by air layering
record.explanation: The PDF lists the Tasar food plant air-layering question with options T. arjuna, T. tomentosa, T. perviflora and T. chebula. Recall of which species is air-layered is uncertain, so T. tomentosa is a low-confidence choice.
